title: Alternative proteins from waste streams: a circular economy roadmap for sustainable food systems
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00829H, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sunny Dhiman, Gunjan Mukherjee, Anu Kumar, Bhanu Krishan
This review examines how waste streams are converted into food and feed proteins using microbes, algae, fungi, and insects, comparing technologies, safety, regulation, and near- and long-term pathways.
